critiques.notes: This is a compelling urban night scene with beautiful color reflections, but suffers from common night photography issues including blown highlights in light sources, moderate noise, and slightly soft focus. The primary improvements should focus on recovering highlight detail in the brightest lights and adding crispness to the skyline while preserving the vibrant, energetic atmosphere of the nighttime cityscape.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce highlights by -15 to -20, particularly in the blown-out orange/yellow street lights and building lights to recover detail and reduce halation
improvements_detailed.reason: Many light sources are clipped and lack definition, creating distracting bright spots that pull attention from the overall composition

improvements_detailed.action: Apply selective sharpening to the building silhouettes and skyline using masking, avoiding over-sharpening the water reflections
improvements_detailed.reason: The buildings appear slightly soft, and targeted sharpening will add definition and clarity to the architectural elements while maintaining the natural blur in reflections

improvements_detailed.action: Lift blacks by +10 to +15 and add subtle shadow recovery to reveal more detail in the dark sky and building shadows without losing the night atmosphere
improvements_detailed.reason: Some shadow areas are crushed to pure black, losing subtle detail that would add depth while maintaining the nighttime mood

improvements_detailed.action: Apply luminosity noise reduction in the dark sky areas while preserving color noise in the reflections for texture
improvements_detailed.reason: Visible noise in the dark sky is distracting, but controlled reduction will clean up the image while maintaining the textural quality of the water

improvements_detailed.action: Enhance color saturation selectively in the blue and cyan tones of the water reflections by +10 to +15 to create better color separation from the warm lights
improvements_detailed.reason: Boosting the cooler tones will create more visual interest and complementary contrast with the warm city lights
